view: close three-quarter, slightly-low front view; collar worn open, top button unfastened, both collar-stand front ends parted and facing camera; invisible ghost mannequin

geometry.wearer_left_stand_end: SQUARE: straight vertical front edge meeting the band's top and bottom edges in two crisp 90-degree corners, zero corner radius; carries the single horizontal buttonhole; this is the overlapping (top) end and in the blueprint's closed front view its squared edge is drawn on the viewer-left of center front
geometry.wearer_right_stand_end: ROUND: one continuous convex curve of radius about half the band height (~1.75 cm), no corner anywhere along the front profile; carries the single sewn button; this is the underlapping end and in the blueprint its rounded profile is drawn emerging on the viewer-right below the collar point
geometry.buttons: exactly ONE collar-stand button (one, not two), sewn on the rounded wearer-right end; one horizontal buttonhole on the square wearer-left end
geometry.collar: semi-spread collar with edge stitching, worn open with points spread naturally; no tie
geometry.placket: standard sewn button placket with TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and one visible placket button below the stand
geometry.stand_topstitching: single row of edge topstitching ~6 mm inside every stand contour: it turns the sharp 90-degree corner on the square end and sweeps smoothly around the curve on the round end

ratios: stand height ~3.5 cm = roughly three stand-button diameters (NOT the extra-tall 5.0 cm band)
round end curve radius = about half the band height
each stand end extends ~1.5 cm (a bit over one button diameter) past the placket edge
buttonhole length ~1.4x button diameter, centered in band height
locked_features: wearer's LEFT stand end square (straight vertical edge, two crisp 90-degree corners, zero radius) — appears on the RIGHT side of the frame in the front-view photo
wearer's RIGHT stand end fully rounded (continuous convex curve, no corner) — appears on the LEFT side of the frame in the front-view photo
exactly ONE stand button, sewn on the rounded end; exactly ONE horizontal buttonhole, on the square end
standard stand height ~3.5 cm; ends must NOT be rendered as a taller two-button band
collar worn open, no tie, both end profiles simultaneously visible
standard placket with two parallel topstitch rows and visible placket button
red blueprint lines are shape highlights only — rendered as white fabric with normal white/tonal stitching, never red
distinguishing_vs_siblings: cs-square has BOTH ends squared and cs-round has BOTH ends rounded; this option is the only asymmetric one — one square end (wearer left) and one round end (wearer right) visible together. cs-square-2btn / cs-round-2btn use a taller band with TWO stacked buttons, whereas this option has ONE button on a standard-height band. csh-50 is the extra-tall 5.0 cm band; this stand is standard ~3.5 cm.
uncertain: Blueprint red marks at the closure are faint; a small pink blot below the buttonhole circle was read as red highlight shading, not a second button (single-button reading also follows from the separate 2-button sibling options).
Exact stand height is not annotated on the drawing; 3.5 cm is the standard default (distinct from the csh-50 5.0 cm option).
Round-end radius (~half band height) is inferred from the drawn curve; the small source image (224x226) limits precision.
